title: API keys under load
summary:
Authentication gets less contentious under load, while nova-fast gets a working Bedrock route and a fallback.

API-key usage tracking no longer adds synchronous database writes to authentication requests, reducing contention that could cause invalid-key errors under high concurrency. Non-critical tracking failures no longer produce auth error logs.

nova-fast and Claude 3.5 Haiku moved from the legacy Lambda proxy to native Bedrock configuration, addressing the proxy’s unsupported-model response for nova-fast.

Nova Micro remains nova-fast’s primary model, with Nova Lite configured as a fallback when the primary fails, including on rate limits.
